description.value: Peek A Boo Japanese Bistro is a sit-down Japanese restaurant located in a unit at 1297 56 Street in Tsawwassen, Delta. It offers a full lunch and dinner service for cyclists touring the South Delta area, which is popular for its flat terrain and connections to the Tsawwassen ferry terminal. The bistro format suggests a more relaxed dining experience than fast casual, making it a reasonable rest stop on a longer ride.
